name: i9_8_rank_boards
steps: lua:local types={1,2,3,4,6,15,22,24,25,26,27,37,38} __vc_rank_done={} local rl=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.RANK_LIST) for _,t in ipairs(types) do rl:loadRankList({t},true,function(code,reply) __vc_rank_done[t]={code=code,reply=reply} end) end

lua:local bad={} for _,t in ipairs({1,2,3,4,6,15,22,24,25,26,27,37,38}) do local r=__vc_rank_done[t] if not r or r.code~=xyd.error.OK or type(r.reply.rank_list)~='table' or #r.reply.rank_list~=1 or r.reply.rank_list[1].rank_type~=t then table.insert(bad,t..':'..tostring(r and r.code)) end end if #bad>0 then error('vc-rank-boards-'..table.concat(bad,',')) end
note: Real client MID 301 for every implemented rank subtype. Backend.lua adds app_v, platform and v_ to the request; this proves the dispatcher accepts them and that each board answers its own subtype. Subtype 8 (achievement points) is left out because it recomputes every player inside one request and times out on the populated suite database (obligation I9-RANK-AP-SCALE); native tests cover its logic on a small cohort.
